native: Now I'd like to show you Macintosh in person.

local: All of the images you're about to see on the large screen
ja_pron: Kore kara daigamen de goran itadaku subete no eizō wa
native: All of the images you're about to see on the large screen

en: the first time I met and I'd be in this ring. Never expressed a computer's use that place.
zh: 我第一次見到它，我會在這個環中。從未表達過電腦的用途。
ja: 初めて会った時のことです。このリングの中にいます。コンピューターの使い方を表現したことはありません。
local: the first time I met and I'd be in this ring. Never expressed a computer's use that place.
ja_pron: Hajimete atta toki no koto desu. Kono ringu no naka ni imasu. Konpyūtā no tsukaikata o hyōgen shita koto wa arimasen.
native: the first time I met and I'd be in this ring. Never expressed a computer's use that place.

en: I'll be the last one for you. But right now, I'd like to sit back and listen.
zh: 我會是你最後一個。但現在，我想坐下來聆聽。
ja: 私はあなたにとって最後の存在になるでしょう。しかし今は、ゆっくり座って聞きたいと思います。
local: I'll be the last one for you. But right now, I'd like to sit back and listen.
ja_pron: Watashi wa anata ni totte saigo no sonzai ni naru deshō. Shikashi ima wa, yukkuri suwatte kikitai to omoimasu.
native: I'll be the last one for you. But right now, I'd like to sit back and listen.

en: So it is with the silver goat ride that I introduce a man who's been like a father to meet.
zh: 所以我借著銀色的山羊騎行介紹一位像父親般的人。
ja: それでは、シルバーゴートライドに乗って、父のような存在の男性をご紹介します。
local: So it is with the silver goat ride that I introduce a man who's been like a father to meet.
ja_pron: Soredewa, shirubā gōto raido ni notte, chichi no yō na sonzai no dansei o goshōkai shimasu.
native: So it is with the silver goat ride that I introduce a man who's been like a father to meet.
